Passes an item only the first time it shows up, so an alert fires once instead of on every run. It remembers in memory: a server restart forgets.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.dedupe` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Identify items by (`field`) | text | no | `id` | The field that tells items apart, e.g. id, tokenId or txHash. |
| New again after (`forget`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `24h` | How long an item counts as seen. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
